knowledge.what: the capability tables, walkthroughs and the 1,607 bundled documentation pages

checked.what: the connection routes, the dashboard and the safety rules, against release notes and source

changes.what: A user's Restrict IP list now also applies to API-key and OAuth requests, so a key can be refused from an unlisted address.
The Print IRS 1099 Forms button was removed from the IRS 1099 report.
Automation rules exist (triggers, waits, branches). This pack does not cover building them yet.
More actions and record lookups now check permissions, so an API user may need extra roles.
Permissions are checked on records used in accounting, stock, asset, manufacturing and project actions.
Profit and Loss and Balance Sheet can be grouped by accounting dimension.
In BOM, Work Order and Job Card, Track Semi Finished Goods / Make in Stages is now called Produce an Item at Each Operation. This pack's bundled pages use the old name.
Frappe has a built-in MCP server, and lists can be grouped with totals.
Rate limits are now counted per endpoint.
BOM Creator was rebuilt as a design workspace; this pack's steps for it describe the old screen.
The Desk has Delete All, which removes a record together with everything linked to it. Treat it as irreversible.
API responses leave out fields the signed-in user may not view, so a missing field is not an empty one.
New sites use Chrome to make PDFs from print formats.
